description: This is a source code file for the LeaveTypeService class within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It defines service methods related to leave types, including fetching eligible leave types for an employee, retrieving leave type details as an array, and managing internal DAO and utility service instances.

classes.name: LeaveTypeService
classes.description: Service class providing operations related to leave types, including retrieval, filtering based on employee entitlement, and normalization.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of LeaveTypeDao, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: getEligibleLeaveTypesByEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches leave types for a given employee, optionally including leave types with allocated leaves.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeAsArray
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a leave type as an array, including handling of deleted leave types.
